sections.title: Claims aren't just a cost. They shape the final impression of the journey.
body: When disruption happens, the claims experience becomes the "end" of the trip.
points: Handled poorly: frustration, complaints and lost loyalty
Handled well: trust, retention and future revenue

image.alt: Airline passenger at the end of a journey

sections.title: From intake to closure.
sections.sub: Cura handles the full claims lifecycle.

items.title: AI-assisted workflows for faster claim handling
Claim submitted
items.body: Claims arrive from every channel and are matched to the booking.

items.title: Fraud detection
items.body: Each claim gets a risk score; anything above the threshold is flagged.

items.title: Verification
items.body: PNR verification against passengers, flights and dates, and OCR of expense receipts.

items.title: Payout & closure
items.body: Compensation is paid through your providers and the passenger is told the outcome.

sections.title: The request never reaches your team.
sections.body: Same escalation, same authority, same deadline — a completely different week for the people running the operation.

before.title: Evidence is assembled by memory, months late.

items.text: Legal emails OCC asking what happened on a flight from three months ago.
NOTAMs, CTOTs and weather have to be reconstructed from whatever was saved on the day.
Thin evidence means paying claims the airline should have defended.

after.title: Evidence is sealed at the moment of the disruption.

items.text: Every source is fetched over an API the moment the request lands — in parallel, in minutes.
No one in OCC is interrupted. The read-only API is wired up once, at onboarding.
The airline defends what it can defend, on the record, with a checksum per document.

sections.title: The team behind Plan3.
body: Cura is developed by AviLabs, the same team behind Plan3, trusted by airlines for passenger disruption management. We've spent over a decade building products that work in real airline operations — not around them.

items.question: Do we have to replace our existing systems?
items.answer: No. Cura connects to the systems airlines already run — CRM, payout, PSS, email ingestion, FlightAware, WorldTracer, METAR/TAF weather and more.

items.question: Does Cura handle authority requests?
items.answer: Yes. Cura pulls the evidence over an API when a request arrives, drafts the response in the authority's own structure and files it.

items.question: Who builds Cura?
items.answer: AviLabs, the team behind Plan3, with over a decade of aviation technology.
